dev_wrong.mistake: missing translation instead of NULL category
dev_wrong.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id) AS products_without_category
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN category_translation ct
  ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
WHERE ct.product_category_name IS NULL

SELECT AVG(oi.freight_value) AS avg_freight_per_delivered_order
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

SELECT c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH distinct_categories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT product_category_name
    FROM products
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_translation_count
FROM distinct_categories dc
LEFT JOIN category_translation ct
    ON dc.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
WHERE ct.product_category_name IS NULL

dev_wrong.mistake: measured from estimated date, not purchase
dev_wrong.sql:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_estimated_delivery_date
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF('day', order_estimated_delivery_date, order_delivered_customer_date)) AS average_delivery_time_days
FROM delivered

heldout_wrong.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS revenue FROM order_items oi
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM customers WHERE customer_state = 'SP'
SELECT AVG(payment_value) AS avg_paid FROM payments

WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS purchase_month, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_score
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN reviews AS r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-09-01'
    GROUP BY purchase_month
)
SELECT purchase_month, avg_score FROM monthly_avg ORDER BY avg_score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_paid
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND pr.product_category_name = 'beleza_saude'
